_note: Which process a question gets, chosen by the nature of the question. The purpose is to be boring when the question is boring: a terminology question must not trigger a literature sweep. Edit this file when a route is wrong, not the skill prose.

gate.note: Checked before any retrieval, for every class below.

_announce_note: State the route in the answer, for example 'this is a drug-interaction question, so I am going to the label'. A misroute must be visible rather than silently producing a confidently wrong shape of answer.

classes.match: what is X; what does this test measure; what does this term mean
dose; interaction; contraindication; adverse effect of a named drug
does X work; is X effective; what does the evidence say about X
a person has a symptom, or asks what a symptom means for them
